title: Your growth will expose people who were only comfortable with your stagnation. 💊💥
paragraphs: Your growth will expose people who were only comfortable with your stagnation. 💊💥
They want you in their circle, just not above their level. As soon as you start climbing, the hands come out to pull you back down. Don’t let their insecurity become your anchor.
The path of a Gospel Warrior is often lonely because it requires leaving the crowd behind to chase the Calling. Keep your eyes fixed on the Cross, not the critics below. ⚔️⛰️
🔥 "For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ.” - Galatians 1:10
Are you climbing or are you settling?👇
